user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: navigation_flow - Complete User Journey
proposed_scenarios.description: Test the general navigation workflow based on the discovered data, ensuring users can access and explore the website's homepage
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify users can successfully access and navigate the homepage as the first step in exploring the website
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a general user, I want to access the homepage so that I can explore the website's content and features

expected_results: Critical elements of the homepage are verified
Navigation to the homepage functions as expected
edge_cases_to_test: What happens if the homepage takes a long time to load
How does the homepage behave on different screen sizes
What happens if the user navigates to the homepage with an invalid query parameter
data_requirements: Support for multiple browsers and devices
